summary: Convert arbitrary text into a URL-safe slug: lowercase, hyphen-joined, accents folded to ASCII, punctuation removed.

requirements.trigger: slugify is called with a string of words separated by spaces
requirements.behavior: return the words lowercased and joined by single hyphens

requirements.trigger: the input contains accented or non-ASCII Latin characters
requirements.behavior: fold them to their closest ASCII equivalent

requirements.trigger: the input contains punctuation or repeated separators
requirements.behavior: drop the punctuation and collapse runs of separators into a single hyphen, with no leading or trailing hyphen

requirements.trigger: the input contains no slug-able characters
